# gnap — GNAP

[All groups](README.md)

## gnap grant

Request a GNAP grant (RFC 9635): send a grant request bound to the client key with HTTP message signatures (RFC 9421, Content-Digest RFC 9530). With interact, send the person to the AS, verify the finish hash on a loopback redirect and continue the grant. Checks token key binding, continuation and errors.

MCP tool: `gnap_grant`. Opens a browser and waits for a person.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--grant-endpoint` | string | AS grant endpoint. **Required.** |
| `--access` | json | Access rights: [{"type":"photo-api","actions":["read"]}] or references ["read-photos"]. **Required.** |
| `--interact` | bool | Ask for redirect interaction and finish on a loopback URI. |
| `--finish-port` | int | Loopback port for the finish redirect. Default `8769`. |
| `--sub-id-formats` | list | Also request subject information in these formats (opaque, iss_sub, email...) |
| `--client-key` | string | Client private key (PEM or private JWK; Ed25519, P-256/384 or RSA). Default for grant: a new Ed25519 key. May be a file path (CLI or profile only). Over MCP it must be passed in the call, never taken from a profile or the environment. |
| `--key-id` | string | keyid for signatures; default the JWK thumbprint. |
| `--open-browser` | bool | Open the system browser automatically. Default `true`. |
| `--wait` | int | Seconds to wait for the person to finish in the browser. Default `180`. |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).

## gnap continue

Continue a GNAP grant at its continuation URI (polling, or after interaction with interact_ref).

MCP tool: `gnap_continue`. **Changes data at the remote system.**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--continue-uri` | string | continue.uri from the grant response. **Required.** |
| `--continue-token` | string | continue.access_token.value. **Required.** Secret: falls back to `IDPDBG_CONTINUE_TOKEN`, redacted in traces. Over MCP it must be passed in the call, never taken from a profile or the environment. |
| `--interact-ref` | string | interact_ref from the finish redirect. |
| `--client-key` | string | Client private key (PEM or private JWK; Ed25519, P-256/384 or RSA). Default for grant: a new Ed25519 key. May be a file path (CLI or profile only). Over MCP it must be passed in the call, never taken from a profile or the environment. |
| `--key-id` | string | keyid for signatures; default the JWK thumbprint. |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).

## gnap rotate

Rotate a GNAP access token at its management URI and check a new value is issued.

MCP tool: `gnap_rotate`. **Changes data at the remote system.**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--manage-uri` | string | access_token.manage.uri. **Required.** |
| `--token` | string | access_token.manage.access_token.value. **Required.** Secret: falls back to `IDPDBG_TOKEN`, redacted in traces. Over MCP it must be passed in the call, never taken from a profile or the environment. |
| `--client-key` | string | Client private key (PEM or private JWK; Ed25519, P-256/384 or RSA). Default for grant: a new Ed25519 key. May be a file path (CLI or profile only). Over MCP it must be passed in the call, never taken from a profile or the environment. |
| `--key-id` | string | keyid for signatures; default the JWK thumbprint. |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).
